PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  July 11, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, July 11, 2019,
at 2:02 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Lt. David Salcedo, Police Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on June
27, 2019 and pull the Special Meeting on June 27, 2019.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Inglewood Police Department to host National Night Out 2019 at Grevillea
  Avenue between Queen Street and Regent Street, August 6, 2019, from
  5:00 p.m. - 7:30 p.m., subject to “No Parking” signs need to be posted min.
  72 hours prior to event on Grevillea; IPD to designate 4 uniformed Officers
  (ON DUTY) for security detail; the north and south end of Grevillea at
  Queen/Regent must be blocked off by Police or TCO vehicle(s) with a
  vehicle to blocking traffic; barrier must be erected between hot grill area
  and public; lost and found/information booth to be identified and have
  access to loudspeaker for missing children and/or emergency notification
  to crowd (DJ may also be used as announcer speaker); first Aid/CPR
  equipment to be readily available at IPD booth; no Aerial Drone
  video/photograph without FAA / LAX and IPD approval; Vapor K-9 to
  sniff/check area prior to event startup; Canopies to be tied down or
  weighted down to avoid flying away; first Aid station to be clearly marked;
  and Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage, local, state and federal laws.
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00276013)
 Permits & License Committee  July 11, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 5

Item #2:  Northgate Gonzalez Market to host a Back to School Health Fair at 10801
  Prairie Avenue, August 10, 2019, from 9:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m.; approval for
  one day event within commercial parking lot; must have (2) uniformed
  licensed security guards for potential / anticipated crowd control;
  reflective vests shall be worn by security guards when directing traffic
  within parking lot; security guards are not allowed to directing traffic
  on public streets; barriers (bicycle, metal rack type or other
  appropriate wood or plastic “saw horse” type) are required to
  separating pedestrians from vehicle traffic within parking lot and
  adhere to all local, state and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00275974)

Item #3  David Rice DBA Taste of Inglewood to host a food and vendor fair
  with live performances at Inglewood High School (front and interior)
  231 S. Grevillea Avenue, August 4, 2019, from 11:00 a.m. – 7:00
  p.m., subject to additional recommendation from continuing event
  preparation; the following are the Inglewood Police
  recommendations:

Police Staffing :
   1 Lieutenant (incident commander),
   1 Sergeant
   4 police officers assigned with PD bicycles
   2 officers assigned in separate PD marked patrol units (2x) as roving
  perimeter patrol for the event
   7 officers assigned foot beat duties
   1 K9 officer + Vapor Wake k-9 and K-9 vehicle (foot beat/safety checks)
   1 Command Van driver
   1 Command Van
   4 patrol cars to be parked in designated areas for high visibility of Police

Total = 15 officers + 1 canine, 1 Lieutenant, 1 sergeant Hours 10am – 8pm.

SECURITY- Must be identifiable as security by their uniform/clothing by general
public and IPD by a uniform or at least a shirt with badge and “SECURITY” insignia
clearly visible identifying themselves as security; all security must be licensed by
State of Ca. Consumer Affairs and City.
Drones - No drone aerial video/photography without FAA/LAX and IPD approval;
operator must have certification/license to operate a drone; Plans for Drone flight
operation safety plan must be provided to IPD.
Performers/Dignitaries/Presenters - Coordinator to provide list of following at
least 7 days prior to event; Invited dignitaries (political, notable music artists,
actors, radio personalities, sports figures, performers, speakers, or any guests that
would attract crowd and/or media). Barriers- Vehicles shall be used as barriers at
the north and south end of event to avoid unauthorized vehicles disturbing/driving
through event without authorization. TCO’s shall be posted at each end with
vehicles. Physical barriers shall also be used at designated intersections/locations.
 Permits & License Committee  July 11, 2019
Minutes  Page 3 of 5

Water filled stand-alone plastic type barriers are acceptable, however Meridian
traffic barriers preferred (Meridian barriers not required).
Alcoholic Beverages - All vendors selling Alcoholic beverages shall have valid
ABC license presented to IPD 7 days prior to event. No glass bottles to public,
plastic cups only. Alcohol sales only in designated areas (tent/beer garden area).
No Sales or possession of alcoholic beverages to those prohibited from drinking
(underage), no alcohol sales to those persons obviously intoxicated by alcoholic
beverages and/or intoxicated or under the influence of drugs including cannabis.
At least one (1) security guards shall be posted at beer garden entrance, two (2)
security guards within the beer consumption area to make sure people do not take
alcoholic beverages outside beer garden area. No sales or consumption/smoking
of cannabis products – per current laws.
Signage at each entrance point - font size shall be clearly visible to be
addressed/approved by IPD.
There shall be visible and readable signage for:
   No underage consumption/possession of alcoholic beverages
   No sales/use or consumption of illegal drugs including cannabis (marijuana)
  and cannabis products (by law)
   No sales, smoking of cigarettes, cigars, vapes, or other tobacco products,
  etc.
   No weapons of any type (knives, firearms, glass bottles, clubs, or any object
  that could be used as a weapon – PD review)
   Police has right to deny entry to anyone and/or expel subjects from event
  that may pose a threat or disturbance per 415 PC
   Subjects cannot bring in their own alcoholic beverages for
  sale/consumption.
Lighting
Must have adequate lighting for night/dusk hours.
Health/Safety:
Shall have portable toilets, hand sanitation area, with signage
Designated Lost and Found area with loudspeaker/announcement capabilities for
lost children and lost/found personal items.
First Aid station to be clearly marked.
Tents/Canopies to be tied down or weighted down to avoid flying away with wind.
Any and all cooking areas to have a barrier from public and children are to be kept
away from hot cooking areas
Each food stand/vendor shall have designated trash can for their trash and trash
bags.
All food items to be in compliance with the Los Angeles County Health Department
mobile food facilities and mobile support guide and regulations for food
preparation, care, storage and packaging.
Fire Safety briefing shall be provided to all vendors. Fire Safety plan shall be in
place (to be overseen by Fire Department).
Vehicle Parking
Parking plan shall be presented to PD asap but no later than 7 days prior to event.
Parking signage/direction shall be posted.
 Permits & License Committee  July 11, 2019
Minutes  Page 4 of 5

DIAGRAM/MAP – VENDORS/PRESENTERS
Will need a diagram of vendor/kiosks and tent/canopy locations with contact phone
numbers and names of responsible parties. List to be provided 7 days prior to
event.
LAW - Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
noise and signage, local, state and federal laws.
Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned may result in the
revocation of your business license and any future business license
application requests.
APPLICANT AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE
PARTICIPANTS IN CALLING/NOTIFYING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED,
UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL, AND/OR ACTIVITY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A
POLICE RESPONSE OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT
SERVICES (I.E. CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, PUBLIC
WORKS, ETC.)

  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00275681)

Business License Request(s):

Item #4:  Sam Hyun Bae Chung DBA Inglewood Beauty Salon to operate a hair
  salon at 232 N. Market Street, subject to payment of annual business
  license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and maintain valid and
  current Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from
  the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers,
  Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the establishment is required
  to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner shall provide
  valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable
  state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; shall apply/submit application
  for permit for other social/party events. Consumption of alcoholic
  beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted
  on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted;
  Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage, local, state and federal laws. APPLICANT
  AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN
  CALLING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL,
  AND/OR ACTIVTY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE RESPONSE
  OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT SERVICES (I.E.
  CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.) Failure to comply
  with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application request. Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00275980)
 Permits & License Committee  July 11, 2019
Minutes  Page 5 of 5

Tobacco Retailer License Request(s):

Item #5:  In Sun Chang DBA Bob’s Drive in Dairy to operate as a tobacco retailer at
  326 W. Arbor Vitae Street, subject to sales of single cigarettes is strictly
  prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to
  minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; persons purchasing tobacco or
  any related tobacco products shall have valid identification on their person
  at all times to enforce laws restricting underage access to tobacco use,
  including hookah products; “NO LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,”
  and “NO PANHANDLING” signage must be posted outside of the business;
  sales of marijuana and cannabis products, narcotics and narcotics
  paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used to ingest other narcotics such as
  base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine, including glass cylindrical tube
  and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke and/or ingest narcotics; sales of
  Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e.,
  clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited;
  Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their
  designees is subject to random Permits & Licensing establishment
  inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police and Code
  Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is to enforce business
  establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood
  and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live bands/music,
  disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business owner(s) is required
  to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all applicable IMC rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00275130)

Business License Renewal Request(s):

Item #6:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax;
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, state and federal law and standard
  business recommendation applicable to each business type. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity
  No.
  1  Silk Nails  Hair/Nail Salon  00249884

  2  First of All Barber Salon  Hair/Nail Salon  00275067

  3  Inglewood Jewelry & Loan Pawn Shop  00249963

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:34 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
